function: Joint DOA estimation, phase-gain-error estimation and symbol detection in an uplink ISAC MIMO receiver with PA nonlinearity, I/Q imbalance and array gain-phase errors (p. 2-3).
system: Uplink mmWave ISAC MIMO: BS with N=20-element ULA, K=3 single-antenna IoT users, 16-QAM, 500 pilots plus 100 data symbols; no RIS; carrier frequency not given (p. 3, 11).
method: Signal-flow-inspired NN (sub-NN pairs, fully connected, cross-weight layers) supervised on pilots with MSE loss, then Bayesian message passing on the trained NN (p. 4-5, 10).
data_channel: Custom simulation: ULA N=20, K=3, DOAs drawn in three angle intervals, Gaussian gains CN(0,1/N), fifth-order polynomial PA, IQI; PGE sigma_a=0.15, sigma_phi=15 deg; no dataset or measurements (p. 11).
test_conditions: NN trained on the 500 pilots of a frame, inference on 100 data symbols; sweeps over SNR, snapshots, PGE, PAN levels, Rapp model; no separate train/test scenario (p. 11-13).
baselines: DOA: MUSIC, SDAC [13], ENAL [11], CRB; detection: ZF, multistage SDAC+LS+RP receiver, learned MP-NN [47]; modeling: RP polynomial [48], model of [47] (p. 11-13).
metrics: DOA estimation MSE (with CRB), NMSE of system modeling, symbol error rate (SER) (p. 11-13).
complexity: Overall O(Md T N K + Md T Ñ K + P K Ñ + P K^2 N), covering NN training and message-passing inference (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 11: "The channel gains in vector hk are Gaussian distributed" with a custom ULA model, DOAs drawn at random. Missing: any 3GPP, COST 2100 or DeepMIMO model, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 5: "We train the NN model using a limited number of pilot signals." The NN is trained on the pilots of the condition tested. p. 13: "we evaluate its performance under a different nonlinear model" (Rapp), but the paper never says a model trained on one PAN model or scenario is tested on another.
q3_support: p. 13: "including the proposed receiver, the multistage receiver, the MP-NN in [47] and zero forcing (ZF) based receiver" (SER, Fig. 11). Ref. [47] is p. 14: "Message passing on neural networks", an earlier paper of the same authors. Non-learned: ZF, multistage, MUSIC, ENAL (p. 12).
q4_support: p. 11: "Overall, the proposed method requires a complexity of" O(Md T N K + Md T Ñ K + P K Ñ + P K^2 N), from the Complexity Analysis section for the NN training and the inference.
q5_support: p. 11: "Assume that the BS is equipped with a ULA, N = 20 and K = 3" is a custom simulation. Missing: any code or data link or DOI, and any public or measured dataset.
notes: Included as area 1: the detection function (SER) is MIMO detection; DOA and PGE estimation are joint sensing and calibration tasks and no beams, waveforms or resources are designed, so not area 5 (reviewer may confirm). The learned part is a pilot-trained NN surrogate used inside message passing (Algorithm 1, p. 10). q2 is 0 because the paper does not state a cross-condition test of a trained model; the Rapp test (p. 13) trains on pilots of that condition as far as stated. The Rapp model [49] is from IEEE 802.11ad evaluation methodology, for the amplifier, not the channel.
